classification_rule.domains: Domain YAML identities are pinned; complete semantics means exactly the six fields temporal_kind/time_field/natural_key/filter_dims/storage_mode/permissions, with non-null temporal_kind and query permission for deferred candidates.
classification_rule.canonical_provider_models: Provider/model/module:class rows are frozen from batch3 smoke and cross-checked against the static catalog LazyFetcherBinding canonical_model_ids (or module basename fallback); all 347 entries match exactly.
classification_rule.deferred_domains: Query-semantic domain identities with at least one exact frozen provider/model binding; every one of the 314 query-semantic domains has a frozen binding.
classification_rule.legacy_dwd_domains: The 20 domain YAML entries with no complete semantics group; these remain the daily DWD measurement surface.
classification_rule.ods_legs: The 33 registered source/domain legs on those legacy domains are split by the 10 explicit legacy freshness-field mappings present in the pinned AkShare/THS mapping YAMLs; the remaining 23 are explicitly unmapped.
